Pianissimo, close and dry, in tune at A = 440. Beatless, no pulse. The dyad holds exactly the same for the full 30 seconds: no movement, no swell, no new notes, no ending.
Instrumental only, no vocals. Avoid: percussion, any rhythm, piano, shimmering or glassy high sounds, low bass, swells, risers, impacts, stingers, melody, and any resolution.
